[LSER.16.11.1] Three v1 aggregations characterise the *temporal structure*
of event-driven boolean and rate signals — `active_fraction`
(time-in-state), `onset_rate` (rising-edge rate), and `integral`
(time-weighted ∫x dt) — and extend the matrices of [LSER.17]–[LSER.18].
Their semantics, backings (`SeriesBackendIntervalPulse`, `SeriesBackendNumericIntegral`; `onset_rate` reuses `SeriesBackendRingBuffer`), the
`gap-policy` phrase ([LSER.13.5]), determinism, and bounded-memory
availability are specified normatively in
[LSIG].
